✦ AXIOM FLEET FOR CAR RENTALS

Get in the fast lane.

To the future

The car rental industry today demands a new level of service experience. Good cars and great drivers are the bare minimum. There is a need for accuracy, real-time transparency, and a seamless post-service experience. A business needs efficient management to deliver this competitive advantage. Axiom Fleet provides you with a complete suite of tools needed to pave the way to great customer service and satisfaction.

UNIFIED PLATFORM

Car rental management like never before.

Experience all aspects of your car rental operations through a single easy-to-use dashboard. A cutting-edge, web-based platform designed to streamline your operations. Enable better control over drivers and enhance employee productivity. Above all provide an accurate overview of your business instantly — while ensuring the highest standards of information security.

100% Real-time accuracy
Paperless Duty slips
Tally Out-of-the-box
PRODUCTIVITY & SCALE

Boost your business with the same team.

Axiom Fleet’s workflow and automation tools are tailored to eliminate human bottlenecks, allowing your car rental business to achieve more with the same workforce.

⚙

Make it Your Own

Build personalised workflows and processes needed to meet your company’s and customer’s requirements. From creating invoices just the way they ask to the reports needed to meet your strategic goals.

Configurable Workflows
🌐

Grow Globally

Deliver the same level of service experience as some of the biggest names in the industry. Manage multi-city branches, inter-city dispatches, and corporate clients with ease.

Enterprise Scale
⚡

Experience the Magic in the Details

Built by understanding the nuance of the Indian car rental industry in great detail:

  • Monthly duty types & split billing
  • Whichever is higher extra calculations (KM vs Hours)
  • Revenue sharing & attached DCO payouts
  • Dynamic fuel surcharge formulas
Indian Market Nuance
OPERATIONS & DISPATCH

Let the Bookings Flow.

A complete booking, allotment, and service delivery solution designed to delight your customers.

📋

Create or Import Any Booking Type

Single, recurring, monthly, or CSV batch imports. Set up booking creation systems based on your customer’s needs.

🏷

Build Unique Workflows

Use labels like VVIP, Airport, Outstation, and Custom priority tags for better identification and workflow management.

🔄

Real-time Updates

Instant status changes as it happens: Requested ➔ Allotted ➔ Dispatched ➔ In Progress ➔ Completed ➔ Billed.

📞

Integrated Communication

Talk with passengers and drivers through a secure call-masked click-to-call system, SMS, and WhatsApp alerts.

🤝

Car Rental Associate Network

Work with car rental associates in your network. Send and receive booking requests with partner fleets seamlessly.

🚘

Availability Management

A single place to view and manage driver and vehicle availability, duty schedules, and maintenance downtime.

📍

Build Allotment Efficiency

Quick view driver location and proximity for intelligent allotment optimisation and dead-mileage reduction.

📱

Digital Duty Slips

Completed duty slips available instantly using the Axiom Go Driver App — with opening/closing KM, garage KM, tolls, and OTP signatures.

BILLING & RECEIVABLES

Customer First: Invoicing & Receivables

Set up invoice creation to be in line with your customer’s requirements. No matter how many customers you serve, you can account for the unique requirements of each customer to serve them efficiently and error-free.

🧾

Customer-centric Invoicing

A complete management suite for all invoicing needs:

  • Single-duty and consolidated invoices
  • Manual invoicing overrides
  • Automated tax & entity selection (CGST/SGST/IGST)
💳

Complete Customer Payment Oversight

Complete management suite for incoming payments:

  • Advance customer collections
  • On account ledger tracking
  • Bulk and single invoice payment reconciliation
📄

Complete E-invoicing Control

Seamless Government GST E-invoice creation (IRN & QR code generation), cancellation, and dispatch logs.

🔗

Axiom Collect

A first-of-its-kind fully automated payment collection system with instant payment links sent via WhatsApp and SMS.

✍

Digital Signature Support

Integrated digital signing solutions for passenger verification and corporate duty slip signoffs.

📬

Invoice Statements & Dispatch

Build monthly ledger statements, manage courier and email dispatches, and track physical delivery proofs.

FLEET COSTS & PAYABLES

Purchase and Expenses

From fuel expenses and vehicle EMIs, to any costs incurred by drivers during the course of the trip, you can track and manage all your expenses efficiently in one place.

📑

Supplier Invoice Management

Centralise all supplier invoices in a single place. Receive and verify attached car owner (DCO) and vendor bills directly in your dashboard.

💵

Petty Cash & Driver Payroll

Automate driver payroll calculations, trip allowances, batta, overtime, and maintain a clear digital cash book.

📊

Duty Specific P&L

Get accurate and real-time information on duty level profitability (Revenue vs Operating Cost) as soon as a duty slip is closed.

⏳

Supplier Payment Management

Keep track of pending supplier invoice payments, advance adjustments, and payables aging schedules.

⛽

Vehicle Fuel & Mileage

Automate mileage visibility (KM/L) and fuel cost management with price-point tracking across petrol, diesel, and CNG.

🛠

Vehicle Expenses

Get deeper insights into vehicle profitability through easier vehicle expenses management: EMIs, maintenance, insurance, and permits.

INTELLIGENCE & ACCOUNTING

Better Data for Better Business.

Get valuable insights into your car rental operations with data that can help you understand and manage your operations better.

📈

Quick Summary Views

View key operational overview information (Total duties, unallotted, on road, completed, billed) right on the duties roster.

📂

Customised Data Exports

Create your own export formats. Select columns, filters, date ranges, and export clean CSV/JSON datasets.

💼

Export to Tally

Seamless out-of-the-box integration with Tally Prime and Tally.ERP 9 to serve all your Indian accounting needs.

📊

Build your Own Reports

Access complete reporting freedom with customer, supplier, vehicle-group, and city profitability reports on demand.
